notes.title: Thank you for your participation.
notes.notes:
All of this was a social experiment that began a few months ago when I began working on my game. At first, I just wanted to make a game, give it away for free and move on with my life. However, after a short while, I realized that I could do something no one has ever done, and whilst I still wouldn't make any money from it, at least I could get a few laughs. Oh, and laugh I did indeed. 

The price was just a way in which I could invite the curiosity of people to check out what is going on, and from there the rest would happen by itself. The entire goal was not only to prove but also to verify the facts of the current reality we live in.  I have heard of media twisting stories, and of "woke" people attacking anyone that even just slightly disagreed with their beliefs. 

For this reason, I made sure that I wasn't promoting any "misogyny" or "transphobia", but just making up a sci-fi story that mentioned that there are only two genders we can use for reproduction, which are as we all know, biologically present in all mammals. All that was necessary is to come up with a story of an alternative future in which we would come extinct because of the fact that we no longer reproduce sexually, as we were designed to do by millions of years of evolution. 

There is nothing controversial about the story itself, as it was just about a young boy, trying to figure out his way of life. And since no one could play the game during the height of the hype, no one could check that there was nothing crazy about it. This is what we call "the perfect storm".

So what did I manage to verify? Well, the media did indeed twist the story to their own agenda, which you can see here: 
[url=https://twitter.com/ThePro_X/status/1618796014076592135]Yes, I made a Twitter account for this.[/url] 

I also sent the game to a woke steam curator as a "temperature check" about two months before the release itself. After the curator did as I expected by posting a biased review, I was given a green light to continue with my plan.

Between the 23rd of January and the 26th of January 2023, we have been featured in articles in over a dozen of countries such as the US, the UK, Australia, Taiwan, Poland, Germany, Turkey, Italy, France, Slovakia, and many more, featured in numerous large gaming news articles including PC Gamer, IGN, Kotaku, and more, which gave us the option to see who is promoting "far-left wing" or "woke" propaganda and who is being unbiased. If any of the details interest you, feel free to ask in our [url=https://discord.gg/H3w9tQm]Discord Server[/url]

I would also like to make it clear, that I myself, am politically neutral. I do not lean towards the left or the right, as I am not the one to make those decisions here. I just wanted to see what is the current state of the world and the direction we are heading in consequently, as we all know a new world order is about to introduce itself, and if you happen to be on the wrong side, you might be one of the people that we talk about to this day since World War Two.

I must admit, I am surprised at how much attention can something that has no real effect on people's lives do. But at the same time, this also gave me a lot of courage, as I feel no fear towards the extremists. The reason behind this is that even though I have had death threats and numerous unfounded accusations of things I did not do, or do not agree with, after a few days of "hype", it is all gone. 

This has only proven to me one thing that Mr. Jordan Peterson said once. [i](Note that I am paraphrasing here.)[/i] "The way I avoid crazy people is that I just have my lectures at 8 a.m. before they wake up." I am certain I got the sentence wrong there, pardon me for that, but the point largely remains the same. If there are people that hate you, but their hate is not rooted in any real basis and they are not disciplined at the same time, there is nothing to fear.

The broader message I was trying to share, is the same as the one word that the game brings up when you start it. "Think." Whilst I have received a lot of hatred, there have been a few exceptional people that came up to me, even from the trans community itself, and they have supported me as they believe in my message.

There is a lot more to the entire story, but unless I make a 2-hour long video going into detail, I will not try and write an essay here. I prefer talking to people in person, over writing academic papers, call me old-fashioned.

I can guarantee that we will meet again in the future, as I am quite interested in psychology and human behavior. And since there is no better way to understand humans than experimenting in practice, we will have to be back once again.

I would like to thank everyone for participating in this experiment, I am officially calling the hype off, as the purpose of this mission has been fulfilled.

[i]There are many details I have not covered in this letter, just as many details I left out of the story which was partially based on my own life. Once again, if you are truly interested in knowing more and perhaps even just leading a rational discussion, [url=https://discord.gg/H3w9tQm]our discord server[/url] is the place to do so.[/i]

Also, a small detail that might be important and I forgot to include:

As you can see over all our steam forum, or the discord server if you joined, I have not censored a single individual. I have kept the good, and the bad and let you make up your own mind. This is something most media did not do in contrast, as they only shared one side of the story. I know that most of you have probably noticed that I made a few jokes here and there, just to ensure that the fire keeps burning whilst it is still needed.
